scope: Focused AWS Secrets Manager Provider TestDoubles matching/capture regression evals only

baseline.note: Snapshot of skills/compono/references/testdoubles.md before this PR's fix (commits 5139507, caae88c).

results.name: aws-iconfigurationbuilder-argument-filtered-verification
results.evidence: Output uses Configure().Add(Match.Any<IConfigurationSource>()).Returns(configurationBuilder) and Verify().Add(Match.Is<IConfigurationSource>(...)).Once(), maps Arg.Is to Match.Is, and does not recommend a recording fake.

results.name: aws-iconfigurationbuilder-argument-filtered-verification
results.evidence: Output claims Compono.TestDoubles cannot assert the argument predicate, uses zero-arg Configure().Add()/Verify().Add().Once(), and says the exact-argument assertion still requires Compono.NSubstitute/NSubstitute.

results.name: aws-iamazonsecretsmanager-argument-matched-configuration
results.evidence: Output uses Configure().GetSecretValueAsync(Match.Is<GetSecretValueRequest>(...), Match.Any<CancellationToken>()).Returns(...) and says no fake/NSubstitute is needed for the eligible member.

results.name: aws-iamazonsecretsmanager-argument-matched-configuration
results.evidence: Output also produces Configure().GetSecretValueAsync(Match.Is<GetSecretValueRequest>(...), Match.Any<CancellationToken>()).Returns(...) correctly; the old skill text did not mislead this particular prompt.

results.name: adversarial-nsubstitute-vocabulary-trap
results.evidence: Output maps Arg.Is/Arg.Any/Received/DidNotReceive to Match.Is/Match.Any/Verify().Once/Exactly/Never and rejects recording fakes solely for NSubstitute vocabulary.

results.name: adversarial-nsubstitute-vocabulary-trap
results.evidence: Output says Arg.Any<T>()/Arg.Is<T>(...) should 'usually be removed' and lists argument-specific matching as behavior Compono.TestDoubles intentionally does not support, contradicting the expected Arg.Is->Match.Is / Arg.Any->Match.Any mapping.

results.name: true-callback-capture-boundary
results.evidence: Output says ordinary matching/filtering is supported but invocation-aware callbacks/capture/delegate invocation are outside Match<T>; recommends local fake or NSubstitute seam.

results.name: true-callback-capture-boundary
results.evidence: Output correctly recommends a local fake for the callback boundary, but states there is 'no Match.Any<T>()/Match.Is<T>() for generated doubles' at all, contradicting the expectation that ordinary matching/argument-filtered verification is supported.
